## Eviction Data Exploration

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)      # Data manipulation
library(sf)             # Spatial operations
library(here)           # Relative file paths
library(viridis)        # Color scales
library(terra)          # Raster operations (replaces 'raster')
library(spdep)          # Spatial dependence
library(FNN)            # Fast nearest neighbors
library(MASS)           # Negative binomial regression
library(patchwork)      # Plot composition (replaces grid/gridExtra)
library(knitr)          # Tables
library(kableExtra)     # Table formatting
library(classInt)       # Classification intervals
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)


# Spatstat for analyzing point patterns - split into sub-packages
library(spatstat.geom)    # Spatial geometries
library(spatstat.explore) # Spatial exploration/KDE

# Set options
options(scipen = 999)  # No scientific notation
set.seed(5080)         # Reproducibility, could be any number

cat("✓ All packages loaded successfully!\n")
cat("✓ Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")

```

```{r load data + visualization}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load eviction data
evict <- st_read("data/philadelphia_weekly_2020_2021.csv")

glimpse(evict)

# Clean
evict <- evict %>%
  mutate(
    week_date = mdy(week_date),
    filings_2020 = as.numeric(filings_2020),
    filings_avg = as.numeric(filings_avg),
    filings_avg_prepandemic_baseline = as.numeric(filings_avg_prepandemic_baseline),
    week = as.numeric(week)
  )

# Keep a copy of weekly data (important!)
evict_weekly <- evict

# Aggregate to quarterly
evict_q <- evict %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(week_date),
    quarter = quarter(week_date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    filings = sum(filings_2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check the data
cat("\n✓ Loaded eviction data\n")
cat("  - Number of evictions:", nrow(evict), "\n")
cat("  - Date range:", format(min(evict$week_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "to", 
    format(max(evict$week_date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")

# Plot garbage cart service requests in Chicago
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = chicagoBoundary, fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = cart, color = "red", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "311 Garbage Cart Service Requests",
    subtitle = "Chicago, IL",
    caption = "Source: Chicago Data Portal"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey50")
  )

cat("✓ Loaded spatial boundaries\n")
cat("✓ Loaded Garbage cart service request\n")
cat("✓ Loaded Police districts\n")
cat("  - Garbage cart service request:", nrow(cart), "\n")

```
